turns.user: đợt vừa rồi jensen huang bị dính tới vụ bê bối nào?
turns.assistant_text:
Theo thông tin từ các báo chí quốc tế gần đây, **Jensen Huang (CEO của Nvidia)** đã vướng vào một vụ bê bối cá nhân và an ninh nghiêm trọng:

### 1. Thừa nhận quan hệ ngoại tình và nghi vấn gián điệp
* **Vụ việc:** Jensen Huang đã thừa nhận có mối quan hệ ngoại tình với một nữ doanh nhân người Trung Quốc. 
* **Nghi vấn an ninh:** Nữ doanh nhân này đang bị các cơ quan chức năng Mỹ điều tra vì nghi vấn liên quan đến hoạt động thu thập tình báo cho Bắc Kinh và cáo buộc giúp Trung Quốc tiếp cận các dòng chip AI tiên tiến của Nvidia trái với quy định hạn chế xuất khẩu của Mỹ.

### 2. Cuộc điều tra độc lập từ Nvidia
* Hội đồng quản trị Nvidia đã thông báo khởi động một cuộc điều tra độc lập liên quan đến mối quan hệ này và các nguy cơ ảnh hưởng đến công ty cũng như quy định an ninh.

### 3. Phản ứng của Jensen Huang
* CEO Jensen Huang đã gửi thư xin lỗi đến gia đình và toàn thể nhân viên Nvidia, thừa nhận hành vi sai trái của mình.
* Ông đã hủy xuất hiện tại một số sự kiện quan trọng trong ngành, chẳng hạn như hội nghị *ElevenLabs Summit* và *Anthropic CEO Forum*.

### 4. Tác động tới ngành AI và Nvidia
* Bê bối gây chấn động ngành công nghệ và giới đầu tư AI, khiến giá cổ phiếu Nvidia sụt giảm ngay sau khi tin tức bùng nổ, đồng thời gia tăng sức ép giám sát từ chính giới Mỹ trong bối cảnh cuộc đua công nghệ chip AI giữa Mỹ và Trung Quốc đang diễn ra gay gắt.

items.title: Jensen Huang pulls out of ElevenLabs Summit amid Nvidia controversy | TechCrunch
items.summary:
Posted:

# Jensen Huang pulls out of ElevenLabs Summit amid Nvidia controversy

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has pulled out of the ElevenLabs Summit scheduled for this Wednesday in New York, ElevenLabs, the voice AI company, confirmed Monday. He has also dropped out of other speaking engagements, including the Anthropic CEO Forum. Nvidia is an investor in ElevenLabs. [...] The withdrawals comes after Huang admitted to an extramarital affair over the weekend, and Nvidia opened an investigation into his relationship with a possible Chinese spy.

“I owe my family and all of you an apology. I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry,” Huang said in a memo to the company. [...] The incident has rattled the AI industry, raising questions about Huang’s staying power as CEO and Nvidia’s own China ambitions.

items.title: How the Jensen Huang Scandal Unfolded - Business Insider
items.summary:
Nvidia CEO and cofounder Jensen Huang's admission to having an extramarital affair has triggered an independent investigation into the billionaire businessman.

The affair has also raised questions about whether Huang will remain the CEO of the $4.5 trillion AI chipmaker, though the company's board has said it has confidence in his leadership. [...] In the wake of the scandal, Jensen Huang is no longer set to attend an Anthropic-hosted private CEO forum Monday in Montecito, California.

He was set to be interviewed by an Anthropic executive, a person familiar with the event told Business Insider. Jensen Huang is no longer expected to attend, a second person familiar with the matter said. [...] Jensen Huang was not among the initial list of top executives set to join President Donald Trump for his May visit to China. News organizations pointed out the curious absence given that the Nvidia CEO had joined Trump on similar occasions.

In a seemingly last-minute decision, Huang joined the trip when Air Force One made a refueling stop in Alaska. Trump published a Truth Social post calling out CNBC for reporting Huang's absence.

items.title: Why is Nvidia’s Jensen Huang at the centre of a US-China spy scandal? | Technology News | Al Jazeera
items.summary:
US authorities have been investigating Megaspeed since 2024 over suspicions that the company helped China obtain advanced Nvidia chips in violation of US export restrictions.

However, no criminal charges against Jensen Huang or Alice Huang have been reported. The controversy has prompted bipartisan pressure in Washington. [...] After the revelations, Nvidia – whose market capitalisation of $4.5 trillion is higher than the gross domestic product (GDP) of Japan, the world’s fourth-largest economy – saw its stock price tumble by more than 4 percent in trading overnight into Monday.

The controversy erupted as Washington seeks to prevent China from obtaining advanced American semiconductors, including Nvidia’s most powerful artificial intelligence chips, as the US and China fiercely compete for AI supremacy. [...] [

By Usaid Siddiqui

Published On 9 Nov 20269 Nov 2026

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is facing questions over allegations that a Chinese businesswoman with whom he had a romantic relationship was gathering intelligence for Beijing.

items.title: Jensen Huang spy scandal rocks AI race
items.summary:
What to watch: Huang's scandal comes amid a dramatic reversal of political fortunes for the AI industry, as voters rejected data center expansion and handed control of Congress to Democrats promising tougher oversight. [...] Why it matters:Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has fashioned himself as the indispensable leader of an indispensable company — a $4.5 trillion behemoth with unparalleled clout in Silicon Valley, on Wall Street and inside President Trump's White House.

   Trump stood by Huang on Sunday evening, telling reporters that the Nvidia CEO is "an honorable guy" and "probably has an excuse" for his infidelity. [...] Jensen Huang and President Trump at a 2025 White House event. Photo: Andrew Harnik/Getty Images

The world's most powerful AI executive admitted Sunday to an affair with a suspected Chinese spy, sending shock waves through an industry built on his singular influence.
